title: Soil
$comment: Static fields describe the profile and come from data/profiles; dynamic fields start from the profile and are changed by effects during a trajectory.

order.description: Static. Dominant SiBCS soil order (English names; Latosol = Latossolo, etc.). Source: IBGE soil map 1:250,000 (R045). Filling it per profile is task S1 in docs/tasks/data-usage.md.

N2.description: Dynamic stock of total nitrogen in the top 0-30 cm. Initial value is derived from SoilGrids total nitrogen and bulk density; crop-cycle changes use explicit, uncalibrated fixation-minus-harvest-export assumptions. Total N is not mineral or directly plant-available N.

pH.description: Dynamic. pH in water, 0-30 cm weighted. Source: SoilGrids phh2o (ph_water in data/profiles). Changed by liming.

organic_carbon.description: Dynamic. Soil organic carbon, 0-30 cm weighted. Source: SoilGrids soc (organic_carbon_g_kg). The current model varies it per trajectory and uses it in transition weights and yield.

available_water_capacity.description: Static. Water the soil can hold for plants down to 1 m (AWC). Source: SoilGrids texture + Saxton & Rawls pedotransfer (available_water_capacity_mm).

available_water_fraction.description: Dynamic. Share of the AWC currently filled. Updated by the water balance (rain - ETc). Replaces the v1 discrete water state: low <= 1/3 < medium <= 2/3 < high, so a transition can test it with 'when'.

temperature_per_depth.description: Static or climatology. One item per depth, so depth and temperature always have the same length. Source pending: task S4 in docs/tasks/data-usage.md.
